title: Skip & SkipWhile
description: Learn to skip elements in collections using Skip and SkipWhile operators.

data.text: Partitioning operators split a sequence (collection) into two parts and return one of the parts. The `Skip` and `SkipWhile` operators skip elements and return the rest.
The `Skip()` method skips the specified number of elements starting from the first element and returns the rest of the elements.

data.title: Skip Example

data.text: The `SkipWhile()` method skips elements as long as the specified condition is true. Once the condition becomes false, it returns all remaining elements.

data.title: SkipWhile Example
data.content: Skipping elements while condition is true

data.title: SkipWhile with No Skipping
data.content: When first element doesn't satisfy condition

data.text: The second overload of `SkipWhile` includes the index of each element:

data.title: SkipWhile with Index
data.content: Skipping based on element and index

data.title: Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: Skip and SkipWhile are not supported in C# query syntax. Use method syntax only.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Skip skips a specified number of elements from the start
SkipWhile skips elements while condition is true
Once SkipWhile condition becomes false, returns all remaining elements
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about Take and TakeWhile.
